long_description:
Buildings of the ancient world from the 0 A.D. game art (Wildfire Games, CC-BY-SA 3.0): an Alexandrian lighthouse, Kushite pyramids and the temple of Amun, a Ptolemaic temple, a Greek temple, a Han temple and Briton roundhouses.

Requires the **sagas** mod, which places these landmarks during map generation
where their site fits and builds them from the materials of the game and the site.

| Landmark | Size | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Temple on the hill | 39 x 35 x 57 | peak or ridge or plain |
| Temple of the Han | 33 x 36 x 41 | plain or slope or ridge |
| Lighthouse of the harbour | 15 x 43 x 27 | cliff+coast or coast |
| Temple by the river | 34 x 40 x 45 | plain+river or plain |
| Pyramid of Meroe | 16 x 35 x 28 | plain or slope |
| Small pyramid | 8 x 19 x 11 | plain or slope |
| Roundhouse | 12 x 14 x 15 | plain or slope |
| Temple of Amun | 48 x 41 x 59 | plain+river or plain |

Every schematic is an adaptation of a freely licensed model; see ATTRIBUTION.md for sources.
